question: Which parts in the JM-200 joint module are custom and which are catalog items?
referenceSql: SELECT b.line_no, p.part_no, p.description, p.source_type, b.qty_per FROM inventory.bom_lines b JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = b.part_no WHERE b.assembly_no = 'JM-200' ORDER BY b.line_no

question: Which parts have only one supplier quote, and where is that supplier?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, p.description, MIN(s.name) AS supplier, MIN(s.country) AS country FROM procurement.rfqs r JOIN procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = r.part_no GROUP BY r.part_no, p.description HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which quotes would miss the need date if we ordered on the quote date?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, s.name AS supplier, q.lead_time_days, q.promise_date, r.need_date FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id WHERE q.promise_date > r.need_date ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which quotes come from a supplier that cannot hold the tolerance the part needs?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, p.tolerance_mm AS needed_mm, s.name AS supplier, c.min_tolerance_mm AS supplier_best_mm FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = r.part_no JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id JOIN suppliers.supplier_capabilities c ON c.supplier_id = q.supplier_id AND c.process = p.process AND c.material = p.material WHERE c.min_tolerance_mm > p.tolerance_mm ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which custom parts could be replaced by a catalog item, and what does each cost against the best quote?
referenceSql: SELECT p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd AS catalog_price, MIN(q.unit_price_usd) AS best_quote FROM inventory.parts p JOIN inventory.part_equivalences e ON e.part_no = p.part_no JOIN inventory.catalog_items c ON c.catalog_sku = e.catalog_sku JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.part_no = p.part_no JOIN procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id WHERE p.source_type = 'CUSTOM' GROUP BY p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd ORDER BY e.match_confidence DESC

question: Which suppliers are AS9100 certified, and when does it expire?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, c.expires_on FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN suppliers.supplier_certifications c ON c.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE c.certification = 'AS9100' ORDER BY c.expires_on

question: Which suppliers do we hold the most stock from?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS units_on_hand FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN inventory.warehouse_inventory i ON i.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY units_on_hand DESC

question: How many units are on order from suppliers in each region?
referenceSql: SELECT s.region, COUNT(*) AS open_orders, SUM(p.qty_ordered) AS units_on_order FROM procurement.purchase_orders p JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY units_on_order DESC

question: Which in-transit purchase orders arrive first, and from which supplier and carrier?
referenceSql: SELECT p.po_id, p.sku, s.name AS supplier, h.carrier, h.eta_date FROM procurement.purchase_orders p JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN inventory.shipments h ON h.po_id = p.po_id WHERE p.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' ORDER BY h.eta_date

question: How many shipments does each carrier have?
referenceSql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS shipments FROM inventory.shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY shipments DESC

question: How much stock is in each warehouse?
referenceSql: SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(qty_on_hand) AS units FROM inventory.warehouse_inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id

question: List every line of the JM-200 bill of materials and say whether the part is custom or from the catalog.
referenceSql: SELECT b.line_no, p.part_no, p.description, p.source_type, b.qty_per FROM inventory.bom_lines b JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = b.part_no WHERE b.assembly_no = 'JM-200' ORDER BY b.line_no

question: For the joint module JM-200, which components are made to order and which are standard catalog parts?
referenceSql: SELECT b.line_no, p.part_no, p.description, p.source_type, b.qty_per FROM inventory.bom_lines b JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = b.part_no WHERE b.assembly_no = 'JM-200' ORDER BY b.line_no

question: Show parts where we got just a single quote, with the supplier and its country.

question: If we ordered every quote on the day it was quoted, which ones would arrive after we need them?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, s.name AS supplier, q.lead_time_days, q.promise_date, r.need_date FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id WHERE q.promise_date > r.need_date ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which quotes promise delivery later than the RFQ need date?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, s.name AS supplier, q.lead_time_days, q.promise_date, r.need_date FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id WHERE q.promise_date > r.need_date ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which quotes are from a supplier whose best tolerance is not tight enough for the part?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, p.tolerance_mm AS needed_mm, s.name AS supplier, c.min_tolerance_mm AS supplier_best_mm FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = r.part_no JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id JOIN suppliers.supplier_capabilities c ON c.supplier_id = q.supplier_id AND c.process = p.process AND c.material = p.material WHERE c.min_tolerance_mm > p.tolerance_mm ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Where did a supplier quote on a part whose tolerance they cannot hold?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, p.tolerance_mm AS needed_mm, s.name AS supplier, c.min_tolerance_mm AS supplier_best_mm FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = r.part_no JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id JOIN suppliers.supplier_capabilities c ON c.supplier_id = q.supplier_id AND c.process = p.process AND c.material = p.material WHERE c.min_tolerance_mm > p.tolerance_mm ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which custom parts have a catalog equivalent, and how does the catalog price compare with the best quote?
referenceSql: SELECT p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd AS catalog_price, MIN(q.unit_price_usd) AS best_quote FROM inventory.parts p JOIN inventory.part_equivalences e ON e.part_no = p.part_no JOIN inventory.catalog_items c ON c.catalog_sku = e.catalog_sku JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.part_no = p.part_no JOIN procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id WHERE p.source_type = 'CUSTOM' GROUP BY p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd ORDER BY e.match_confidence DESC

question: For custom parts that a catalog item could replace, what is the catalog price against our lowest quote?
referenceSql: SELECT p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd AS catalog_price, MIN(q.unit_price_usd) AS best_quote FROM inventory.parts p JOIN inventory.part_equivalences e ON e.part_no = p.part_no JOIN inventory.catalog_items c ON c.catalog_sku = e.catalog_sku JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.part_no = p.part_no JOIN procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id WHERE p.source_type = 'CUSTOM' GROUP BY p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd ORDER BY e.match_confidence DESC

question: Who holds an AS9100 certificate and when does it run out?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, c.expires_on FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN suppliers.supplier_certifications c ON c.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE c.certification = 'AS9100' ORDER BY c.expires_on

question: List the AS9100 certified suppliers with their expiry dates.
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, c.expires_on FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN suppliers.supplier_certifications c ON c.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE c.certification = 'AS9100' ORDER BY c.expires_on

question: How many custom parts and how many catalog parts are in each assembly?
referenceSql: SELECT b.assembly_no, p.source_type, COUNT(*) AS parts FROM inventory.bom_lines b JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = b.part_no GROUP BY b.assembly_no, p.source_type ORDER BY b.assembly_no, p.source_type

question: What is the lowest quoted unit price for each part that we have requested quotes on?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, MIN(q.unit_price_usd) AS lowest_price FROM procurement.rfqs r JOIN procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id GROUP BY r.part_no ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which suppliers are in the USA and what processes can they do?
referenceSql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name, c.process FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN suppliers.supplier_capabilities c ON c.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE s.country = 'USA' ORDER BY s.name, c.process

question: Which parts are used in both the JM-200 and the GR-50?
referenceSql: SELECT DISTINCT b1.part_no FROM inventory.bom_lines b1 JOIN inventory.bom_lines b2 ON b2.part_no = b1.part_no WHERE b1.assembly_no = 'JM-200' AND b2.assembly_no = 'GR-50' ORDER BY b1.part_no

question: How many quotes has each supplier given us?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS quotes FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY s.name

question: Which RFQs are due soonest, and how many quotes does each one have?
referenceSql: SELECT r.rfq_id, r.part_no, r.need_date, COUNT(q.quote_id) AS quotes FROM procurement.rfqs r JOIN procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id GROUP BY r.rfq_id, r.part_no, r.need_date ORDER BY r.need_date, r.rfq_id

question: Which suppliers have an ISO 9001 certificate that expires in 2027?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, c.expires_on FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN suppliers.supplier_certifications c ON c.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE c.certification = 'ISO 9001' AND c.expires_on >= '2027-01-01' AND c.expires_on < '2028-01-01' ORDER BY s.name

question: Which supplier gave the lowest quote for the output flange?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, q.unit_price_usd FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = r.part_no JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id WHERE p.description = 'Output flange' ORDER BY q.unit_price_usd LIMIT 1

question: How much of each catalog item is in stock and how long is its lead time?
referenceSql: SELECT catalog_sku, in_stock_qty, lead_time_days FROM inventory.catalog_items ORDER BY catalog_sku

question: Which parts have quotes from suppliers outside the USA, and from which countries?
referenceSql: SELECT DISTINCT r.part_no, s.country FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id WHERE s.country <> 'USA' ORDER BY r.part_no, s.country

question: Which suppliers can do 5-axis CNC milling in aluminum, and how tight a tolerance can each hold?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, c.min_tolerance_mm FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN suppliers.supplier_capabilities c ON c.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE c.process = '5-axis CNC milling' AND c.material = 'Aluminum' ORDER BY s.name

question: What is the average lead time quoted by each supplier?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, AVG(q.lead_time_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM procurement.quotes q JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY s.name
